name: neuro-reader
description: Welcome to **NeuroReader** - an innovative browser extension designed to enhance reading experiences for individuals with dyslexia and autism. NeuroReader aims to make text more accessible and easier to read through customizable features that cater to various reading needs.

scripts.dev: echo "Dev mode — just reload the extension in chrome://extensions"
scripts.copy: cp -r manifest.json content.js popup.* icons/ LICENSE README.md dist/
scripts.minify: terser dist/content.js -c -m -o dist/content.js && terser dist/popup.js -c -m -o dist/popup.js
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy && npm run minify
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run zip

author: xchar08, Betim-Hodza
